title: AI-powered Monitoring of Mangrove Biomass and Carbon Stocks
summary: data354 describes mangrove pilots that combine satellite imagery and field plots to produce biomass maps and carbon estimates.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Pilots in Fresco and Sassandra, Côte d’Ivoire, combine radar, optical, and lidar imagery with 300 ground-truth inventory plots. The system produces monitoring outputs for conservation and carbon accounting, with expansion toward Senegal. The submission does not quantify a restoration effect or resulting carbon-market transaction.
purpose: Improve mangrove biomass and carbon-stock monitoring.
system: AI-powered Monitoring of Mangrove Biomass and Carbon Stocks
location: Fresco and Sassandra, Côte d’Ivoire; Senegal (expansion)

ratings.reason: The described pilots produce biomass maps and carbon-stock estimates from combined imagery and field plots, creating monitoring information for conservation users.
Restoration, carbon-market access, and coastal resilience are prospective effects of the monitoring information.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AI-powered Monitoring of Mangrove Biomass and Carbon Stocks

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.
